verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Enterprise SSO via SAML/OIDC, with user data 'synchronized with Clerk' at sign-in. Nothing in the pack mentions SCIM, directory or group sync, or IdP-driven deprovisioning that revokes app access. SSO-time data sync is an adjacent feature and does not deliver push-based provisioning or deprovisioning, so this applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can sync users and groups from customer directories via SCIM so deprovisioning in the IdP revokes app access
